articles.summary: MANILA, Philippines — June 10, 2026 — Munify, a Y Combinator-backed (S25) cross-border neobank, today announced its integration with the Circle Payments Network (CPN) to support stablecoin-based payouts into the Philippines
articles.title: Munify Integrates with Circle Payments Network to Enable USDC-Powered Local Payout in the Philippines
